name: Dictator
desc:
literally 1984

🌾Harvest wheat in the fields to feed the populace
🏭 Do your part! Produce munitions in the factory for the endless war
🗣️ Chant praises to the Great Leader or vanish for defiance
🧠 Control information, distribute rations, and indoctrinate the Party faithful as Leader
⚔️ Tired of the Leader? Purchase weapons and change the rules by force
🦠 Be careful not to catch the deadly virus - Plague-84
💵 25% of Cash is lost on death/leave - Store it in ATMs to keep it safe!

⭐ Be sure to Like & Favorite the game if you'd like to see more updates

⚠️Game is in early stages of development - All content is subject to change - Leave feedback on the group wall

scripts.title: Infinite Stamina Food Thirst
scripts.features:
- Infinite Stamina - Never run out of energy
- Infinite Food - Stay fully fed at all times
- Infinite Water - Never get thirsty
-Fast Health Regeneration(Not Reliable or Invincible)
- Press 'K' to hide/show GUI
- Works on Xeno
